text:
ivy: Final preflight: Product X launch post draft is ready. Need quick checks on hero wording, benchmark caveat, CTA UTMs, and webinar routing. Plan to publish Fri 9am PT.

sam: Link to preview?

ivy: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1745554321 — please focus on hero + benchmark callout + top CTA mapping.

claire: Hero proposal: 'Sub-100ms median latency for production LLM workloads' — technical and specific. Might be a bit claim-y.

tom: Slightly nervous about 'Sub-100ms' as an absolute. Legal/Product prefer "median latency typically under 100ms" or "near 100ms" to avoid guarantees.

claire: OK: change to "median latency typically under 100ms". Shorten hero to "Median latency typically under 100ms" for the banner.

ivy: Noted. Benchmark blurb currently: "In Dedicated tests we observed sustained token throughput and high fidelity on standard prompt suites." Add a test-config parenthetical?

nina: Yes add config for transparency: "(test config: 8xA100, seq_len=512, mixed-batch workloads)." Collapse on mobile.

ops-bot: Suggested UTM: utm_source=blog&utm_medium=content&utm_campaign=prodx_launch_q2_2026. HubSpot hidden fields: campaign=prodx_launch_q2_2026, lead_source=blog, product_interest=dedicated. Recommend server-side tag 'prodx_launch_q2_2026' for direct CTA clicks.

sam: CTA copy: top hero button "See Product X in action" (webinar) and bottom CTA "Get started" (trial). Use separate UTMs for each action.

ivy: I'll wire both UTMs into the preview. Also adding a small privacy line by the webinar form: "We process contact details according to our Privacy Policy."

legal: Quick flag: avoid comparative phrases like "faster than X" or absolutes like "always", "guarantee". "Typically" and parenthetical test context are good. I'll do a fast pass when you push the edit.

claire: Can we include a placeholder customer quote block so design can finish layout? Something neutral: "Redwood helped us reduce latency and streamline ops" — placeholder label.

ivy: Added placeholder quote and pushed changes to preview. Preview link: https://deploy-preview.redwood.ai/1745554321 (assets pending).

tom: Assets: I'll produce hero banner + benchmark chart once copy final. ETA 90 mins after copy freeze.

ops-bot: Reminder: ensure HubSpot form maps hidden fields and that server-side tag is applied for direct CTA clicks. I'll coordinate with infra to add server webhook for Sales Ops alerts on webinar signups.

ivy: Great. Plan: finalize wording now (hero -> "Median latency typically under 100ms"; benchmark + test config parenthetical; UTMs per ops), tag @legal for 20-min pass, then schedule Fri 9am PT.

legal: Received — will review in 20 and ping if edits needed.

ivy: Thanks everyone — will update here after legal clears. :rocket:
